{"loc":"TABATABAI:6:91-105#8","rows":[{"verses":["6:95"],"words":["*"],"type":"links","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"The Qur'an counters the claim that God is needed only for origination by appealing to observable cosmic order and ongoing change as signs of God's existence and unity.","anchor":"فإن الله سبحانه يستدل على وجود الصانع ووحدته بالآيات المشهودة في العالم","mentions":[]},{"verses":["6:95"],"words":["*"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"The signs include celestial motions, seasonal change, rivers, rain, useful animals and plants, and the stages and transformations of human life.","anchor":"وهو النظام الجاري في كل نوع من الخليقة وما يجري عليه في مسير وجوده وأمد حياته من التغير والتحول والفعل والانفعال","mentions":[]},{"verses":["6:95"],"words":["*"],"type":"theology","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"These conditions and effects form an ongoing chain: each day's events cause the next day's events and depend on what preceded them; independent persistence would invalidate the Qur'anic proofs.","anchor":"وكل مجموع منها في حين علة للمجموع الحاصل بعد ذلك الحين، وحوادث اليوم علل حوادث الغد","mentions":[]},{"verses":["6:95"],"words":["*"],"type":"theology","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Nothing in the world creates itself or is explained by a similar dependent thing; the causal chain must end in God, an existent whose being cannot lapse or change.","anchor":"من الضروري أن شيئا من هذه الموجودات لم يفطر ذاته ولم يوجد نفسه ولا أوجده شيء آخر","mentions":["14:10"]},{"verses":["6:95"],"words":["*"],"type":"theology","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Divine bestowal is not a transfer that leaves its recipient self-sufficient: if a created thing became independently necessary, its dependence and possible destruction would contradict that claim.","anchor":"إذ لو كانت إفاضة الوجود على هذه الوتيرة عاد الوجود المفاض مستقلا بنفسه واجبا بذاته","mentions":[]}]}
